title: Crabominable V cs4aC 040/132 S-Chinese Pokemon TCG 9 Colors Gathering RR
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText:
This Crabominable V card is a must-have for any Pokémon TCG collector! With its stunning design and rare gathering edition, this card is sure to impress. The card is made from high-quality cardstock and features the iconic Pokémon character, Crabominable, in a simplified Chinese language version.

The card is perfect for players aged 6 and above, and is part of the 9 Colors Gathering edition of the Pokémon TCG. It is not a vintage card, but is a 2024 release from The Pokémon Company International. This card is a great addition to any collection and is sure to make your opponents jealous!
